description: A record of a cooling-off/complaint dispatch to a merchant (ADR-2605312500 §3, kurashimori_send). Two `mode`s: `member-self-send` (default, R2 — kurashimori assembled + handed back, the member sent) and `agent-on-behalf` (代行, R3 GATED — kurashimori sent the member's OWN notice via a lawful channel). CONSTITUTIONAL: `agent-on-behalf` is permitted ONLY when the remedy is `council-verified` (G14), per-submission consent is recorded, and the R3 gate (司法書士法/行政書士法 clearance + Council Lv7+) is satisfied (G15); only external action is a lawful, non-harassing communication via a legitimate channel with member authorization (G10); member is the named complainant (G4); no platform-held signing key (ADR-2605231525). Holds metadata + pointers, never inline content (G6).

draftRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the remedyDraft sent

mode.description: G15 — member-self-send is the default; agent-on-behalf (代行) is the GATED R3 exception

channel.description: The lawful channel used (G10); naiyo-shomei = 内容証明郵便

consentRef.description: Per-dispatch consent artifact (G3; mandatory for agent-on-behalf, G15)

councilGateRef.description: For mode=agent-on-behalf: reference to the on-chain Council Lv7+ + 司法書士法/行政書士法 clearance gate (G15). Absent ⇒ agent-on-behalf is invalid.

receiptRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding the dispatch receipt / 追跡番号 (G6)
